full_AB.text: Honey , I have something important to say .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Something important ?

full_AB.text: Yes . I have just booked two tickets .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Tickets ? What tickets ?

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Two air tickets .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Air tickets ?

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Yes . We will fly to Paris the day after tomorrow .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: We ? The day after tomorrow ? What are you talking about ?

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Today is June 18 , isn ’ t it ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Yes . So ?

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Think about it !

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Then it is June 20 the day after tomorrow .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Yes . Think about it carefully .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Oh , come on . Tell me please . Why did you book tickets to Paris ?

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Oh , honey ! Don ’ t you remember this important day to us ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Sorry .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: It is our 10th wedding anniversary this June 20 .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Our 10th wedding anniversary ?

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Of course . You completely forgot it .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Darling . I think you have made a mistake .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: I have made a mistake ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Yes . We married on July 20 ten years ago .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: July 20 ? But I think it should be June 20 .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Yes . We had planned to marry on June 20 , but something happened , so we had to put off our wedding day .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Yes . I remember now . We put it off . I did make a mistake . But how shall we deal with the tickets ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Since you have booked . Then let ’ s celebrate our wedding anniversary before hand .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Could you do me a favor and proofread my resume before I send it out to the human resources department ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Sure , let me take a look ... Personal Information , Education , Experience , Training ... I think you should add another section for language . You speak three languages , so you might as well put that on your resume .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: But languages don't have anything to do with engineering . Shouldn't everything I put on my resume have something to do with my field ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Not necessarily . I think people would be impressed by your language abilities . It says something about your level of intellect and experience . Also , I think human resources directors want to see more of a well-rounded person in a resume .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: It's just a piece of paper , you think that they can tell if I am a well-rounded person by looking at it ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Well , you're right , the resume is limited in how much it can tell someone about a person . That's why job interviews are important to let people know the real you that they can't see from a piece of paper . But resumes can be helpful in explaining things and giving a good impression to a potential employer .

frozen_references.claim: B believes A should include language abilities on A's engineering resume to show a rounded background.
B believes resumes are limited and interviews are important for showing the person beyond the resume.

review_rows.claim: A attributes to B the belief that a resume can reveal whether a person is well-rounded.
B was asked by A to proofread A's resume before sending it to the human resources department.

full_AB.text: What do you think we need to do to get our new branch office running well ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: First , I'd make sure that we have a good , local , corporate lawyer . He or she will know all the local laws and regulations .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: That ’ s very important . A friend recommended a good law firm to me . We ’ ll need someone to hire staff .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: I think that we should send one of our HR people to do that . I don ’ t think we should use an agency , because they won ’ t be familiar with the type of people we employ . Have we decide on the location of

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Yes . We have . We chose the location in the northeast of the city , not too far from the airport and on the edge of the CBD .

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Why didn ’ t we choose an office in the CBD ?

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: The offices there were too expensive . Have we negotiated any contracts yet ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Yes . We ’ Ve signed two contracts with companies that we already do work for in other countries . We hope to sign another three this month .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: When will the branch office open ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Hopefully next month . Everything is a little rushed . We should be able to set up our branch office and expand our business quickly .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: Has and advertising campaign been prepared ?

full_AB.speaker: B
full_AB.text: Yes , it has . We ’ re going to target the business community through business magazines .

full_AB.speaker: A
full_AB.text: I made plenty of business contract on my last visit and through the embassy . We should be able to get plenty of customers .
